The pale diagonal streak on the right and the bottom-right tree remain in the same positions across all frames, serving as static reference points against which the cloud changes are measured.

uncertain_details: The single-frame dark speck could be a bird, an insect, or a brief exposure/occlusion artifact; its identity and motion direction cannot be confirmed from one sample.
The apparent cloud 'motion' is marginal and may be partly slow real drift rather than a clear process; no definite translation vector is established.
No camera pan/zoom is detectable given the fixed tree and streak, but minor handheld jitter cannot be fully excluded.
